think_procedure: Identify the knob’s purpose and valid range/meaning in PostgreSQL.
Check whether any specific numeric value (e.g., 0, -1) switches the knob into a qualitatively different mode (such as disabling a feature) rather than being just a smaller/larger quantity.
If such a mode-switching value exists, classify it as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify it as not special.
